India Joins Global Initiative to Shape 6G Networks

India has joined a US-led global initiative comprising 24 other countries to help shape the development of next-generation 6G networks. The initiative aims to foster international collaboration and set standards for future wireless communication technologies. This move signifies India's participation in defining the technological landscape for advanced mobile networks.
